outcome: Go-live acceptance records both signatures and the client's changes or decline
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4401/go-live` (mock) shows the "Sent to the client" block with the receipt time, a PM block and a Client block each with a signed-copy picker, six signer fields, and a disabled "Record signatures" — verify: open the page; `frontend/e2e/go-live.spec.ts`.

Choosing a file for the Client signer runs the picker upload then `POST /work/{id}/go-live-signoff/proofs` with `role:"Client"`, `receipt_id` from the read, the held `case_revision` and `checked:true` only after the box is ticked; the returned `evidence_id` is then listed from the refetched sign-off read — verify: network panel and unit test on the request body; no proof call is made with the box unticked.

The form cannot submit the same proof id for PM and Client; selecting the same one shows "Choose a different signature record for each signer" and sends nothing — verify: unit test, network panel shows no POST.

With both signers' six fields filled and two distinct proofs chosen, "Record signatures" sends one `POST /work/{id}/go-live-signoff` whose body contains `expected_revision`, `case_revision`, `version_id`, `receipt_id`, `pm_signature_id`, `client_signature_id`, both `signers` objects, `mode:"fresh_signatures"`, `prior_acceptance_id:null`, `note`; on 200 the sections refetch — verify: unit test on the request body; e2e on 4401.
With any signer field empty for either signer, the signer shows "Needs reconciliation" and the submit stays disabled; no value is prefilled — verify: e2e blanks one field; unit test.
On `4406` the `metadata_binding` option appears and, when chosen, sends `prior_acceptance_id:6990`; on `4401` the option is absent — verify: unit tests on both fixtures.

A 409 on the sign-off POST (`4407`) shows the changed-record message, re-reads both reads, keeps nothing as recorded, and a second press sends a fresh body with the new revisions — verify: e2e counts calls and compares revision values.
A double click on "Record signatures" sends exactly one POST — verify: unit test with a slow mock counts calls.
A caller who is not the appointed PM (`4405`) sees no sign-off form, the words "Only the appointed PM records the signatures.", and still sees replies and the unlock list — verify: e2e on 4405.

A work id not on this line, or one that returns 404 (wrong tenant or wrong user), shows exactly "This record is unavailable." with no difference between the two — verify: e2e with two fixtures; unit test on the mapper.
On `4410` (no receipts) no form is drawn and the page says the document has not been sent — verify: e2e.

On `4402` the "Go-live accepted" banner and unlock rows draw only from the reads (acceptance, linked issues count, reviewed handoffs count, milestone name and "Not recorded yet"); there is no "Mark milestone complete" control and no "Hypercare" or "Archive and handover" row — verify: e2e DOM assertions.
On `4406` the accepted banner is not drawn; "An earlier acceptance is on file (#6990)" is — verify: e2e.

Recording a reply (fixture with `capture[]`): the form offers only `changes_requested` and `declined`, only `channels[]` from the read and only the entry's `roles[]`; sending without the attestation tick is blocked; the POST body has `action:"record_reply"`, `receipt_id`, `previous_id`, both revisions, `attested:true` — verify: unit test; network panel.
With `capture[]` empty (`4403`) the reply form is absent and `finding` is shown as the reason — verify: e2e.

`4403` shows the client's quoted note and the Prepare v2 form; submitting sends `{expected_revision, case_revision, inputs:{template_id:null, checklist:null, incident_reporting:null, rollback:null}, reason}` — verify: unit test on the body.

`4404` shows the decline panel: choosing an existing issue sends `link_decline_issue` with `existing_issue_id` and null title, owner and next action; creating a new one sends title, `owner_id` from `owners[]`, `next_action` and null `existing_issue_id`; `prepare_new_candidate` sends the `requirements_id` from the read; `review_remediation` sends `previous_id`, `destination_id` and `role` from `review_options[]` — verify: one unit test per action on the request body.
A decline control for a `reply_id` with no entry in `issues[]`, `new_candidates[]` or `review_options[]` is not drawn — verify: unit test.
`4409` lists the `withdrawn` reply as a read-only history row with no control, and no "withdrawn" option exists in any form — verify: e2e.
`4408` shows "Details not available to you" for a reply whose party, channel, note and date are null and never shows 0, blank or "null" — verify: e2e DOM.

Nothing is sent to the client: no request other than those in the Contract is made by this page, no email or message call — verify: grep `liveApi.POST` and `liveApi.GET` in `frontend/src/features/go-live` lists only the routes in the Contract; network panel on a full run shows none other.

Unit test: the proof upload accepts a PDF and refuses a `.exe` or a file over the picker's limit before any request, and an `UploadId` cannot be passed where an `EvidenceId` is expected (`// @ts-expect-error`) — verify: `go-live` unit tests.

Against live Django (8030, account the appointed PM of a go-live work item) the page's receipts, proofs, replies, `prior_acceptance_id` and milestone match `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/go-live-signoff` and `.../go-live-replies` — verify: compare the page with the `curl` JSON using the session.
A write answered 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once and says to press again; no automatic second POST — verify: unit test counts calls.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: the page matches the SCR-45 boards (header, sent block, signatures, accepted, changes, declined) for the parts kept; hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots at both widths reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-45 artboards.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` still passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High, because a signed acceptance is identity and evidence data that is hard to undo and gates the milestone and later stages. It also has a cross-layer contract: two distinct evidence ids, signer binding and a revision pair, per `backend-answers.md` D-15, D-16, D-1 and `screens-d-delivery-issues-escalation.md` SCR-45. Surfaces are ui, api, auth (the allowed actions are role-dependent), contract-change and product-decision (acceptance wording and outcomes). Product acceptance is required because this is a new client-visible flow that the client must see.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
